physical: Blackish or reddish tinge in nails, eyes, face, skin
digestive: Suspicion of vatagulma or heart disease
Passes stool as liquid, dried, thin, undigested, with sound and froth frequently
vata.speech: Voice feeble, hoarse, depressed, mingled and broken (in vatika disorders)
disease_tendency: Retention of flatus, urine and stool
aggravated_signs: Blackish or reddish tinge in nails, eyes, face, skin, urine and stool

physical: Yellowish or greenish tinge in skin
Yellow tinge in nails, eyes, face, skin
digestive: Burning sensation in cardiac region and throat
Passes undigested bluish or yellowish liquid stool with foetid odour
aggravated_signs: Yellow or greenish tinge in skin, eyes, nails, urine, stool

physical: White tinge in nails, eyes, face, skin
mental: Lack of desire for women (in kaphaja disorders)
digestive: Stool broken with ama and mucus — heavy
aggravated_signs: White or pale tinge in nails, eyes, face, skin, urine and stool
Heavy, slimy and white urine and stool

vata_pitta: Combined etiological factors and characters of both vata and pitta
Bleeding piles with vata association: stool blackish, hard and rough; blood thin, reddish and frothy
Halimaka — green, blackish and yellow complexion with vata and pitta vitiation
pitta_kapha: Bleeding piles with kapha association: stool loose, white-yellow, unctuous; blood thick, fibrous, pale and slimy
Combined disorders of both pitta and kapha simultaneously
vata_kapha: Dry piles predominantly — vatika and kaphaja
Grahani roga with kapha propelled by vayu

sama_prakriti: Tridoshaja piles (sannipataja arsha) — has all etiological factors and symptoms similar to congenital piles
Tridoshaja panduroga — exhibiting symptoms of all three dosas, very troublesome
Tridoshaja grahani — when etiology and symptoms of vata, pitta and kapha join together
Generally considered most difficult to treat and often precursor to many diseases
